newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Intl to lead Enron Development group.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Intl to lead Enron Development group.

text.p: Enron Development Corp said Wednesday Merrill International Ltd will lead Enron's new special projects group in a look at infrastructure projects outside the traditional electric power business.

Under the direction of John P. Merrill Jr., key Merrill personnel will work exclusively for the new group, along with Enron personnel. The group will manage a number of Enron initiatives emphasizing the use of natural gas in infrastructure development, the Enron Corp subsidiary said.
It described Merrill as a leading developer of privately-financed greenfield electric power projects.

"John's broad skills as an international developer will aid EDC in identifying special resources that can be applied to the energy needs of developing markets," said Rebecca P. Mark, EDC chief executive. "His insight into the long-range infrastructure goals of these regions should prove equally helpful to the project management strategies used by Enron Global Power & Pipelines."
